messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Added **Deal name** under **Reproduce a game**. Names now save and return with loaded progress.

Fixed valid pasted saves failing because their JSON fields appeared in a different order. Older saves remain compatible.

Verified 147 unit/static checks and all 83 browser journeys, including focused reruns. Type checking, build, and formatting pass.
